pNone_chapter_1: In a sunlit room filled with shelves of books and simple wooden furniture, Byomkesh Bakshi stands in the center of the frame, fastening the buttons of his crisp white kurta. His expression is one of quiet amusement as he looks toward Ajit, who is rising from a nearby chair with an attentive gaze. The morning light streams through a large window, catching the folds of their traditional Bengali dhotis and highlighting the contemplative atmosphere of the study. Byomkesh’s sharp eyes and lean frame are emphasized as he prepares to depart, while a black rotary telephone sits on a desk in the background.
